def eyes(f):
    S=[n for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='S']
    S.sort(key=lambda n:(n['boundary'][0][1]))
    return (S[0]['boundary'][0][0],S[0]['boundary'][0][1],S[1]['boundary'][0][0],S[1]['boundary'][0][1])
def term():
    return last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('game_over') or last_action_result.get('done')
# Go to TL corner
for _ in range(6): action(['UP'])
for _ in range(6): action(['LEFT'])
print("TL", eyes(current_frame))
tested={}
for v in range(6):
    # sweep full horizontal: LEFT x6 (max apart) then RIGHT x6 (max together)
    for _ in range(6): action(['LEFT'])
    for h in range(13):
        s=eyes(current_frame)
        if s not in tested:
            tested[s]=True
            action(['SPACE'])
            if term():
                print("COMPLETION after SPACE at", s, "state", last_action_result.get('state'),"lvl",last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
                break
        action(['RIGHT'])
    if term(): break
    action(['DOWN'])
    if term(): break
print("distinct states tested with SPACE:", len(tested))
for s in sorted(tested): print(s)
print("final", last_action_result.get('state'),"lvl",last_action_result.get('level_completed'),"over",last_action_result.get('game_over'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
